question: If 14 April 2005 is a Thursday, then what will be the day of the week on 10 May 2017?
solution:
Given: 14 April 2005 is a Thursday.

Now, 14 April 2005 to 14 April 2017 = 12 years (3 leap and 9 ordinary year).

In 12 years = (3 × 2) + (9 × 1) = 6 + 9 = 15 days.

And, from 14 April 2017 to 10 May 2017 = 16(April) + 10(May) = 26 days.

So, total number of days = 15 + 26 = 41 days.

Total odd days in 41 days = 41/7 = 5 week and 6 odd days.

So, 10 May 2017 = Thursday + 6 = Wednesday.

Hence, The correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: 14 April 2005 is a Thursday

Concept:

No. of odd days in non-leap year = Remainder of (365 ÷ 7) = 1 odd day

No. of odd days in leap year = Remainder of (366 ÷ 7) = 2 odd day

After every 7 days and multiple of 7 days, the days repeat themselves.

so when we cross years we need to check whether the given year is a leap or not. The particular day of a year is increased by 1 or 2 odd days on the same day of the next year.

Calculation:

Total number of days in a normal year = 365

Total number of days in a leap year = 366

Total number of odd days in a normal year = 365/7 = 1 

Total number of odd days in a leap year = 366/7 = 2

No of days from 15 April 2005 to 31 Dec 2005 = 16 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 = 261 days

No of odd days from 15 April 2005 to 31 Dec 2005 = 261/7 = 2 days

No of days from 1 Jan 2017 to 10 May 2017 = 31 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 10 = 130 days

No of odd days from 1 Jan 2017 to 10 May 2017 = 130/7 = 4 days

No of odd days from 15 April 2005 to 10 May 2017 = (2 + 4 + (1 × 8) + (2 × 3))/7 = 20/7 = 6 days as 2008, 2012, and 2016 are leap years.

Now, 14 April 2005 (Thursday) + 6 odd days = 10 May 2017 (Wednesday)

Hence, 10th May 2017 will be Wednesday.
